title: hieracium vasconicum subsp. stenoprionatum
intro: Hieracium vasconicum subsp. stenoprionatum, commonly known as Mountain Hawkweed, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Hawkweed include wound healing, pain relief, and anti-inflammatory responses, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids.
